intro: Three pieces, each as the current procedural track and as generated on this laptop by the candidate models. The prompts describe instrumentation, mood, tempo and form only (no artist, work or style is named) and no lyrics are supplied. Nobody has listened to these files yet: every candidate was chosen by measurement, so your ears are the first real test. Text match is the cosine similarity between the audio and the piece's written description (LAION CLAP audio-text model; higher is closer). It says how well the content fits the words, not how real the instruments sound - the procedural tracks, which were composed note by note to the brief, score about 0.5-0.65 on it.

models.title: ACE-Step 1.5 XL turbo
models.note: 4B diffusion transformer, 8 steps - recommended, used for the full set
models.about_html: Size: 4B-parameter diffusion transformer + 0.6B text encoder + 48 kHz stereo audio VAE, 11.1 GB on disk (official Diffusers-format weights ACE-Step/acestep-v15-xl-turbo-diffusers). Licence: MIT for code and weights (bundled text encoder Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B: Apache-2.0); the model card states that generated music may be used commercially. Speed on this machine: 0.35-0.8 s of compute per second of audio at full track length, depending on what else is running - a 2:45 piece renders in 1-2 minutes (the CPU alone needs 2.6 s per second). Acceleration: AMD's PyTorch-for-ROCm 7.1.1 wheels (torch 2.9.0) on the Radeon 8060S with the driver already installed; transformer in bfloat16, VAE in float32, 16 GB of GPU memory.

models.title: ACE-Step 1.5 turbo (2B)
models.note: 2B diffusion transformer, 8 steps - same family, half the size

notes_html: How the files were made. Several seeds per piece are rendered longer than needed; candidates with silence, clipping, dropouts, spectral holes, a wrong tempo, sung or spoken words (checked with a speech recogniser) or genre drift are rejected; the candidate that best matches the description is cut to a loop on bar lines, crossfaded tail-into-head, mastered to -18 LUFS and encoded as OGG Vorbis q0.6 at 44.1 kHz - the XL column holds exactly the files that are in the game now.

Not on this page. YuE 2 (weights are CC BY-NC 4.0 with a creator clause, and its only supported path is Linux + NVIDIA), Stable Audio 3 (weights are gated behind a Hugging Face login and under the Stability AI Community License), HeartMuLa, DiffRhythm 2 and LeVo 2 (song models without a documented instrumental mode or without a verifiable licence). Details and sources: Y:\tools\music_ai\DECISION.md.
